summary: Learn distributed energy resources and microgrid management in 5 days with hands-on sizing, control, protection, and business-case exercises.
lede: Distributed energy resources and microgrid management coordinates local power assets for power-system and facility-energy professionals. It covers site load profiling and critical-load prioritization, hybrid system design, battery dispatch, and transitions between grid-connected and islanded operation. Learners also practice protection and cybersecurity reviews, assess power-quality and reliability measures, and prepare sizing worksheets, concept notes, and implementation plans to support operational decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work with power systems, project planning, or facility energy operations and now need to handle distributed energy resources and microgrid management with more structure. You will benefit most if your role touches design reviews, reliability planning, storage dispatch, interconnection, or resilience reporting.
modules: Hybrid Microgrid Design with HOMER Pro
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop for spreadsheet work and planning exercises. Prior exposure to distribution systems, basic project evaluation, and operational energy terminology will help you get the most from the microgrid control, protection, and financial exercises.
